MORE:
Pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are enclosing herewith the unaudited Financial Results of the Company i.e. M/s G.K. Consultants Limited for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026 duly approved by the Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today i.e. 14th November, 2026 at the Registered Office of the Company. 

The Board Meeting commenced at 1:00 P.M. and concluded at 05:00 P.M.

We are also enclosing a copy of Limited Review Report Report issued by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.
